{
  "150 bytes": (() => {
    // A `FabricBytes` with more bytes than the default array-length limit of
    // 100 renders the bytes below the limit, and then its actual length in
    // place of the rest.
    return new FabricBytes(Uint8Array.from({ length: 150 }, (_, i) => i));
  })(),
}
